contexts.title: FeTeSe: methods and sample scope
contexts.subject: Fe1+δTe1−xSex series, including x = 0.48.
contexts.attribution_note: Retain δ and nominal versus measured composition. The cited NMR source was not captured. No native-edition sample or selected-result association is established.

rows.label: Study methods
rows.summary: Quartz-tube growth; XRD/Rietveld and SEM-EDX characterization; SQUID ZFC/FC at 20 Oe; four-probe resistivity to 14 T.

rows.label: Composition and state
rows.summary: The series includes x = 0.48. Its H ∥ c susceptibility is uncorrected for Fe(II); Table I has no EDX row for x = 0.48.

rows.label: Pairing scope
rows.summary: NMR/d-wave discussion concerns Fe1.04Te0.67Se0.33 and cited x = 0.28/0.33 samples; no pairing assignment for x = 0.48 is established.

rows.label: Magnetic context
rows.summary: Parent antiferromagnetism and substituted-series spin fluctuations do not establish static order at x = 0.48.

contexts.title: κ-H8-Br: ultrasound and thermal history
contexts.subject: Undeuterated κ-[BEDT-TTF]2Cu[N(CN)2]Br with controlled thermal history.
contexts.attribution_note: Disorder provides an internal-pressure proxy; no numerical hydrostatic pressure is recovered. No selected catalogue Tc or result is linked to this source context.

rows.label: Ultrasound study
rows.summary: Undeuterated κ-H8-Br; ultrasound at 30–450 MHz, upward sweeps from 2 K, perpendicular fields to 16 T; ambient external pressure.

rows.label: Thermal histories
rows.summary: Methods: FT before annealing. Figure 1: SL before the 70 K anneal. Keep these reported protocols separate.

rows.label: Pairing scope
rows.summary: A-70K attenuation challenges conventional s-wave behavior; the paper leaves pairing symmetry unresolved.

rows.label: Magnetic and SC context
rows.summary: ≈ 15 K anomaly: the authors suggest an antiferromagnetic interpretation. Near 11.9 K: separate superconducting phase-coherence context.

contexts.title: La4Ni3O9.99: experiment and calculated model
contexts.subject: Polycrystalline trilayer resistance measurements and a separate stoichiometric theoretical model.
contexts.attribution_note: The onset and pressure are already retained in the same catalogue result. Predicted tetragonal I4/mmm and its transition descriptions (10–15 GPa in detailed results; around 20 GPa later) are separate from measured sample structure.

rows.label: Resistance onset
rows.summary: Polycrystalline La4Ni3O9.99 reaches a resistance onset of 23 K at 79.2 GPa, defined by deviation from linear resistance. Authors require further confirmation.

rows.label: Measurement protocol
rows.summary: Four-terminal DAC resistance; boron-doped diamond electrodes and cBN powder. Calibration uses ruby fluorescence through 20 GPa and diamond Raman above 20 GPa.

rows.label: Distinct pressure states
rows.summary: The source reports a resistance drop below 5 K at 32.8 GPa. Field curves at 69.4 GPa (0–7 T) are separate from the 79.2 GPa onset point.

rows.label: Calculated model
rows.summary: DFT/FLEX predictions concern stoichiometric La4Ni3O10, with gap calculations at 40 GPa. Model λ denotes a linearized Eliashberg eigenvalue, not electron–phonon coupling.

rows.label: Order claims
rows.summary: Antiferromagnetic models are cited background. CDW competition is speculative and outside the study scope; observed order and unconventional classification remain unresolved.
